common.tagline: No one should have to go alone.

welcome.title: Someone nearby can be there.
welcome.line1: Teman connects people who need someone beside them with neighbours who have a few hours to give. Always free.
welcome.line2: You say what you need, or when you are free. Someone nearby answers.
welcome.line3: Verified neighbours, no payments, no ratings — just company.

join.phoneHint: We'll send a 6-digit code by SMS.
join.otpHint: From the SMS we just sent. It works for 10 minutes.
join.otpWrong: That code doesn't match. Check the SMS and try again — your typing is kept.
join.otpExpired: That code has expired. We can send a new one.
join.resendWait: You can ask for a new code in {seconds} seconds
join.areaHint: Just the area — never your address.
join.phoneInvalid: That does not look like a Malaysian mobile number. Check it and try again.
join.rateLimited: Too many codes were asked for. You can try again in about {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
join.smsSent: We sent a code by SMS to {phone}.
join.resendIn: You can ask for a new code in {seconds}s
join.nameHint: This is the name people will see.
join.nameEmpty: A name is needed so people know who they are meeting.
join.areaNoneTitle: We could not find that area
join.areaNoneBody: Try a different spelling, or pick the nearest area to you.
